# Key Features:
Kimi K3.1 Pro: Major upgrades to 3D creation, coding, content creation, and financial research.
3D Game Creation: Bring your ideas to life with Kimi game maker. Share your idea and let Kimi generate a multiplayer 3D game with characters, levels, and combat system. Keep polishing the visual and gameplay through conversation.
3D Modeling: Describe an object, building, or scene in text, and bring it to life as a detailed 3D model. Refine the shape and appearance through conversation until it matches your vision.
Agent Swarm: Put multi-agent systems to work on complex projects. Kimi coordinates up to 300 AI agents across 4,000 parallel steps, bringing research, analysis, and report writing together in one workflow.
AI Slides: Make a professional PowerPoint presentation from just a topic or visual reference. Let Kimi turn your ideas into polished slides, with designer-quality layouts tailored to your work and study.
Office Agent: Convert file formats with ease: PDF to Word, Word to PDF, and PDF to Excel. Generate Excel formulas and turn data into charts. Summarize, translate, and comment across multiple files. 
Vibe Coding：Describe your ideal website or share a visual reference. Kimi refines layouts, animations, and interactions through conversation, turning your idea into a usable website with professional code.
Plugins: Connect to authoritative data sources like Wind and S&P. Analyze with professional data you can trust.
Remote Control: Control your computer from your phone — pick up unfinished tasks wherever you are.
Sync Across Devices: Your conversations, files, and work progress stay in sync across devices in real time.
